title: Jerusalem Artichoke Tagine
description: A keto-friendly twist on the traditional Moroccan tagine, featuring Jerusalem artichokes and a blend of Middle Eastern spices.

ingredients.name: Saudi zesty spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped Jerusalem artichokes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to brown.
Add the Saudi zesty spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the artichoke broth and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and braise, covered, for 25-30 minutes, or until the artichokes are tender.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
